install_steps: pipx install ramalama  # or: pip install ramalama
note: Also available as an OS package: Fedora/RHEL 'sudo dnf install ramalama', Homebrew 'brew install ramalama'. Requires podman or docker for container execution (falls back to local llama.cpp/vllm if absent). Set RAMALAMA_CONTAINER_ENGINE=docker to prefer docker; RAMALAMA_TRANSPORT=huggingface to change the default registry.
